(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 3.0: THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES & MHD INDUCTION FLOW VECTOR PROCESSING
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Dynamically updates OECD/NEA benchmark thermophysical properties of Lead-Bismuth Eutectic as a function of bulk
 * temperature T = rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC. Executes vector decomposition of Faraday electromagnetic voltage,
 * applying Hartmann boundary layer flattening, pipe wall conductance shunting, and magnetic Reynolds corrections.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 3.1 Temperature-Dependent Properties of Liquid LBE (OECD/NEA Nuclear Science Handbook Correlations) *)
(* Density rho(T) [kg/m^3]: valid from 125 deg C to 900 deg C *)
rLBE_Density_kgm3 := 11096.0 - (1.3236 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* Dynamic Viscosity mu(T) [Pa*s]: Andrade exponential correlation *)
rLBE_DynamicViscosity_Pas := 0.000494 * EXP(754.1 / (rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC + 273.15));

(* Specific Heat Capacity Cp(T) [J/(kg*K)] *)
rLBE_SpecificHeat_JkgK := 159.0 - (0.0272 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC) + (0.00000712 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* Thermal Conductivity k(T) [W/(m*K)] *)
rLBE_ThermalConductivity_WmK := 3.61 + (0.01517 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC) - (0.000001741 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* Electrical Conductivity sigma(T) [S/m] *)
IF rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC > 50.0 THEN
    rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm := 1.0 / (0.000001 * (0.91 + (0.00072 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC)));
ELSE
    rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm := 950000.0;
END_IF;

(* Volumetric Thermal Expansion Coefficient beta(T) [1/K] *)
IF rLBE_Density_kgm3 > 1000.0 THEN
    rLBE_ThermalExpansionCoeff_1K := 1.3236 / rLBE_Density_kgm3;
ELSE
    rLBE_ThermalExpansionCoeff_1K := 0.000125;
END_IF;

(* Acoustic Sound Velocity in Liquid LBE c_s(T) [m/s] *)
rLBE_SpeedOfSound_ms := 1805.0 - (0.23 * rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC);

(* 3.2 Magnetohydrodynamic Induction Flow Vector Decomposition *)
(* Verify excitation magnetic flux density *)
IF rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T < 0.050 THEN
    rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T := 0.250; (* Default to permanent magnet bias 0.250 Tesla *)
END_IF;

(* Hartmann Number Ha = B * D * SQRT(sigma / mu) *)
IF rLBE_DynamicViscosity_Pas > 0.0001 THEN
    rHartmannNumber := rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T * rPipeInnerDiameter_m * SQRT(rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm / rLBE_DynamicViscosity_Pas);
ELSE
    rHartmannNumber := 150.0;
END_IF;

(* Hartmann Boundary Layer Flattening Factor: K_Ha = 1.0 - (1.0 / Ha) for Ha >> 1 *)
IF rHartmannNumber > 10.0 THEN
    rHartmannFactor := 1.0 - (1.0 / rHartmannNumber);
ELSE
    rHartmannFactor := 0.90;
END_IF;

(* Wall Shunting Correction Factor K_wall accounts for eddy current bypass through metallic T91 pipe wall *)
(* K_wall = (2 * d_in / d_out) / (1 + (d_in/d_out)^2 + (sigma_wall/sigma_lbe) * (1 - (d_in/d_out)^2)) *)
rWallShuntingFactor := (2.0 * rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)) /
    (1.0 + ((rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)) * (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m))) +
     (rWallConductivity_Sm / rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm) * (1.0 - ((rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)) * (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / (rPipeInnerDiameter_m + 2.0 * rPipeWallThickness_m)))));

(* Raw Axial Bulk Velocity from Faraday Law: E_mV * 1e-3 = B * D * v * K_Ha * K_wall *)
rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff := rMHD_MagneticFluxDensity_T * rPipeInnerDiameter_m * rHartmannFactor * rWallShuntingFactor;
IF rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff > 0.001 THEN
    rAxialVelocityRaw_ms := (rFilt_MHD_Voltage_mV * 0.001) / rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff;
ELSE
    rAxialVelocityRaw_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Magnetic Reynolds Number Rm = mu_0 * sigma * v * D (mu_0 = 4*pi*1e-7 H/m = 1.2566e-6) *)
rMagneticReynoldsNumber := 0.0000012566 * rLBE_ElectricalConductivity_Sm * ABS(rAxialVelocityRaw_ms) * rPipeInnerDiameter_m;

(* Non-linear back-reaction magnetic rejection correction: applied when Rm > 0.05 *)
IF rMagneticReynoldsNumber > 0.05 THEN
    rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct := (rMagneticReynoldsNumber * rMagneticReynoldsNumber * 18.0);
    IF rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct > 15.0 THEN rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct := 15.0; END_IF;
    rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms := rAxialVelocityRaw_ms * (1.0 + (rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct * 0.01));
ELSE
    rMHD_InducedFieldRejection_pct := 0.0;
    rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms := rAxialVelocityRaw_ms;
END_IF;

(* Transverse Swirl Velocity Resolution from Orthogonal Electrode Channel *)
IF rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff > 0.001 THEN
    rLBE_SwirlComponent_ms := (rFilt_TransverseVoltage_mV * 0.001) / rTheoreticalFaradayCoeff;
ELSE
    rLBE_SwirlComponent_ms := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Swirl Angle Calculation: theta = arctan(v_swirl / v_axial) in degrees *)
IF ABS(rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms) > 0.05 THEN
    rLBE_SwirlAngle_deg := ATAN(ABS(rLBE_SwirlComponent_ms) / ABS(rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms)) * (180.0 / 3.14159265);
ELSE
    rLBE_SwirlAngle_deg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Validated LBE Mass Flow Rate Determination: m_dot = rho * A_pipe * v_bulk [kg/s] *)
rLBE_MassFlowRate_Voted_kgs := rLBE_Density_kgm3 * rPipeCrossSectionArea_m2 * rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms;
IF rLBE_MassFlowRate_Voted_kgs < 0.0 THEN
    rLBE_MassFlowRate_Voted_kgs := 0.0; (* Prevent negative mass flow during forward cycle *)
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 4.0: ACOUSTIC CAVITATION BUBBLE EROSION TRACKING & LIFE CONSUMPTION
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Liquid LBE cavitation poses severe structural risk to electromagnetic pump throat and steam generator bayonet
 * entrance orifices. Monitors acoustic emission spectral power in the 80 - 350 kHz ultrasonic regime, computes
 * real-time Cavitation Inception Number (Sigma), and integrates cumulative micro-erosion depth via ASTM G32
 * acoustic energy dissipation modeling.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 4.1 Dynamic Pressure & Cavitation Inception Number (Sigma) *)
(* Dynamic head q = 0.5 * rho * v^2 [bar] (converted from Pa to bar via 1e-5) *)
rDynamicPressure_bar := 0.5 * rLBE_Density_kgm3 * (rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms * rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms) * 0.00001;

(* Cavitation Number: Sigma = (P_static - P_vapor) / (0.5 * rho * v^2) *)
IF rDynamicPressure_bar > 0.005 THEN
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := (rLBE_CoverGasStaticPressure_bar - rLBE_VaporPressure_bar) / rDynamicPressure_bar;
ELSE
    rCavitationIndex_Sigma := 99.9; (* High margin at near-stagnant flow *)
END_IF;

(* 4.2 Net Ultrasonic Acoustic Emission Calculation *)
(* Subtract baseline hydrodynamic background noise from total acoustic energy *)
IF rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB > rAcousticBackgroundNoise_dB THEN
    rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB := rVoted_AcousticLevel_dB - rAcousticBackgroundNoise_dB;
ELSE
    rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Convert net dB to RMS acoustic pressure in Pascals: P_rms = P_ref * 10^(dB / 20), P_ref = 1 uPa *)
rAcousticPressure_Pa := 0.000001 * EXP((rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB / 20.0) * 2.30258509);

(* 4.3 ASTM G32 Ultrasonic Cavitation Energy Dissipation & Erosion Rate *)
(* Erosion occurs when net acoustic pressure exceeds threshold (1200 Pa) and Sigma < 1.85 *)
IF (rAcousticPressure_Pa > rCavitationThresholdPressure_Pa) AND (rCavitationIndex_Sigma < 1.85) THEN
    (* Instantaneous erosion rate model: delta_dot [um/hr] = K_mat * (P_acous / P_ref)^1.6 * (f_peak / 100 kHz) *)
    rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr := 0.0085 * EXP(1.6 * LN(rAcousticPressure_Pa / rCavitationThresholdPressure_Pa)) *
                                    (rAcousticResonancePeak_kHz / 100.0);
    IF rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr > 25.0 THEN
        rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr := 25.0; (* Physical saturation limit *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Filter instantaneous erosion rate *)
rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr := rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr + (rCycleTime_sec / (0.2 + rCycleTime_sec)) * (rCavitationErosionRate_um_hr - rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr);

(* Continuous Integration of Cumulative Metal Surface Erosion Depth [um] *)
rCumulativeErosionDepth_um := rCumulativeErosionDepth_um + (rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr * (rCycleTime_sec / 3600.0));

(* Alarm Generation & Debounce on Cavitation Severity *)
tCavitationDebounceTimer(IN := (rCavitationIndex_Sigma < 1.20) OR (rFilt_ErosionRate_um_hr > 4.5), PT := T#2S);
IF tCavitationDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bCavitationRiskExceeded := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Active Cavitation Bubble Collapse Hazard *)
ELSE
    bCavitationRiskExceeded := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Wear Threshold Alarms *)
IF rCumulativeErosionDepth_um > 50.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Cavitation Erosion Level 1 Warning: 50 um wall loss *)
END_IF;
IF rCumulativeErosionDepth_um > 200.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Cavitation Erosion Level 2 Alert: 200 um critical wall loss *)
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 5.0: TRANSIENT THERMAL STRATIFICATION MITIGATOR & RICHARDSON DYNAMICS
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Evaluates vertical temperature profile in large horizontal LBE secondary header via 4-elevation thermocouple rake.
 * Computes gradient Richardson Number (Ri) to quantify buoyancy stability vs inertial mixing shear.
 * Synthesizes dynamic vortex induction stirrer demand to disperse stratified cold boundary layers and alleviate
 * cyclic structural microstrain on conduit weld joints.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 5.1 Vertical Temperature Differential & Mean Temperature *)
rThermalStratificationDeltaT_DegC := rStratHeader_Temp_Elev4_DegC - rStratHeader_Temp_Elev1_DegC;
rMeanHeaderTemp_DegC := (rStratHeader_Temp_Elev1_DegC + rStratHeader_Temp_Elev2_DegC +
                         rStratHeader_Temp_Elev3_DegC + rStratHeader_Temp_Elev4_DegC) * 0.25;

(* Low-pass filter on stratification differential *)
rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC := rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC + (rCycleTime_sec / (0.10 + rCycleTime_sec)) * (rThermalStratificationDeltaT_DegC - rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC);

(* Vertical Temperature Gradient across Header Diameter (D = 0.350 m) [deg C/m] *)
IF rPipeHydraulicDiameter_m > 0.05 THEN
    rHeaderTempGradient_DegCm := rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC / rPipeHydraulicDiameter_m;
ELSE
    rHeaderTempGradient_DegCm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 5.2 Richardson Number (Ri) Stability Computation *)
(* Ri = (g * beta * DeltaT * D_h) / (v_bulk^2) *)
(* g = 9.80665 m/s^2 *)
IF ABS(rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms) > 0.080 THEN
    rRichardsonNumber := (9.80665 * rLBE_ThermalExpansionCoeff_1K * ABS(rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC) * rPipeHydraulicDiameter_m) /
                         (rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms * rLBE_BulkVelocity_ms);
ELSE
    (* Under very low velocity, buoyancy completely dominates inertial shear *)
    rRichardsonNumber := 12.5;
END_IF;

(* 5.3 Stratification Severity & Structural Strain Alert Logic *)
(* Alert threshold: DeltaT > 28.0 deg C OR Richardson Number > 1.25 OR hoop strain > 450 microstrain *)
IF (rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC > 28.0) OR (rRichardsonNumber > 1.25) OR (rHeader_StructuralMicrostrain_ue > 450.0) THEN
    bStratificationAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Thermal Stratification Warning *)
ELSE
    bStratificationAlert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 5.4 Mitigator Vortex Induction Drive Synthesis *)
(* Proportional-derivative mitigation demand to break stratification boundary layer *)
IF bStratificationAlert OR bForceStratificationMitigation THEN
    rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 35.0 + (rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC * 1.8) + (rRichardsonNumber * 4.2);
    IF rCurrentVortexCommand_pct > 100.0 THEN
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 100.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Baseline gentle swirl to maintain uniform temperature distribution *)
    IF rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC > 10.0 THEN
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 15.0 + (rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC * 0.8);
    ELSE
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 5.0; (* Minimum idle circulation swirl *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Enforce Slew Rate Limiter on Mitigator Vortex Command (max 10.0 %/s) *)
IF rCurrentVortexCommand_pct > rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct THEN
    rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct + (rVortexSlewLimit_pcts * rCycleTime_sec);
    IF rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct > rCurrentVortexCommand_pct THEN
        rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rCurrentVortexCommand_pct;
    END_IF;
ELSIF rCurrentVortexCommand_pct < rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct THEN
    rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct - (rVortexSlewLimit_pcts * rCycleTime_sec);
    IF rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct < rCurrentVortexCommand_pct THEN
        rStratificationMitigator_Drive_pct := rCurrentVortexCommand_pct;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 6.0: BAYONET-TUBE STEAM GENERATOR FREEZE-PLUG ISOLATION & SGTR PROTECTION
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Bayonet-Tube Steam Generator (BTSG) operates with high-pressure supercritical/subcritical water inside bayonets
 * immersed in low-pressure liquid LBE. In the event of bayonet tube failure (SGTR):
 * 1. Steam flashes into LBE causing acute pressure surge (dP/dt > 4.5 bar/s or P_steam drop).
 * 2. Rapid freeze-plug protection executes: trips electrical heating to 0 kW, actuates cryogenic jacket cooling.
 * 3. 1D Stefan phase-change solidification propagates radially, freezing LBE solid (< 123.5 deg C) in < 8.0 s.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 6.1 Steam Generator Tube Rupture (SGTR) Detection Logic *)
(* Trigger conditions:
   a) Steam pressure drop rate exceeds 4.5 bar/s while LBE cover gas pressure spikes > 7.0 bar
   b) Disproportionate acoustic noise rise > 35 dB coincident with pressure disturbance
   c) Manual operator freeze command *)
IF (rFilt_SteamPressureRate_bars < -4.5 AND rLBE_CoverGasStaticPressure_bar > 6.5) OR
   (rAcousticWaveguide_ChA_dB > 115.0 AND rLBE_CoverGasStaticPressure_bar > 7.5) OR
   bForceFreezePlugSolidification THEN
    tSGTR_TripDebounceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#150MS);
    IF tSGTR_TripDebounceTimer.Q THEN
        bSGTR_RuptureDetected := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Confirmed Steam Generator Tube Rupture (SGTR) *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    tSGTR_TripDebounceTimer(IN := FALSE);
END_IF;

(* 6.2 Freeze-Plug Phase-Change State Evaluation *)
IF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC <= rFreezePlug_MeltingPoint_DegC THEN
    bFreezePlugIsSolidSealed := TRUE;
    bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Freeze Plug Hermetically Solid *)
ELSIF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC >= 210.0 THEN
    bFreezePlugIsSolidSealed := FALSE;
    bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid := TRUE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Freeze Plug Fully Liquid Open *)
ELSE
    bFreezePlugIsSolidSealed := FALSE;
    bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid := FALSE;
    dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Freeze Plug In Phase Transition *)
END_IF;

(* 6.3 Freeze-Plug Solidification / Melt Control Engine *)
IF bSGTR_RuptureDetected OR bEmergencyTripManual OR bReactorScramActive THEN
    (* EMERGENCY ISOLATION ACTIVATION *)
    (* Trip electrical heating instantly *)
    rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
    (* Actuate cryogenic cooling jacket at 100% capacity *)
    rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 100.0;

    (* 1D Stefan Moving Boundary Solidification Front Estimation *)
    (* ds/dt = [k_sol*(T_melt - T_jacket) - k_liq*(T_core - T_melt)] / (rho * DeltaH_fus) *)
    IF rFreezePlugConduitRadius_m > 0.001 THEN
        rFreezeQuenchCoolingRate_DegCs := (rFreezePlug_MeltingPoint_DegC - rFreezePlug_AnnularJacketTemp_DegC) * 3.8;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0200; (* Freeze Plug Fast Quench Active *)
ELSIF (iState = 0) OR (iState = 10) THEN
    (* COLD STANDBY / CONTROLLED THAWING MODE *)
    IF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC < 250.0 THEN
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 18.0; (* Maximum trace heating for controlled melt *)
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    ELSE
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 8.5;  (* Maintenance trace heating *)
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* NORMAL POWER OPERATION - EQUILIBRIUM ACTIVE BARRIER *)
    (* Modulate heater and cooling jacket to maintain plug core stably at 265 deg C *)
    IF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC < 260.0 THEN
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 10.5;
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    ELSIF rFreezePlug_CoreCenterTemp_DegC > 280.0 THEN
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 2.0;
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 15.0; (* Light trim cooling *)
    ELSE
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 6.0;  (* Steady balance *)
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 7.0: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Implements a 4th-order MIMO state-space dynamic model of the intermediate LBE loop coupled to the BTSG.
 * Model States:
 *   x1: LBE Hot Leg Temperature T_hot [deg C]
 *   x2: LBE Cold Leg Temperature T_cold [deg C]
 *   x3: Bayonet-Tube Heat Transfer Wall Temperature T_wall [deg C]
 *   x4: Header Thermal Stratification Differential DeltaT_strat [deg C]
 * Control Inputs:
 *   u1: LBE MHD Pump Flow Demand [%]
 *   u2: Stratification Mitigator Vortex Drive [%]
 * Solves discrete Luenberger observer: x_hat[k+1] = A*x_hat[k] + B*u[k] + L*(y[k] - C*x_hat[k])
 * Executes receding horizon quadratic cost optimization with input rate and saturation constraints.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

(* 7.1 Populate Discretized System Dynamic Matrices (A, B, C, D) *)
(* Discretization of continuous physics: dx/dt = Ac*x + Bc*u at Ts = 0.010 s *)
(* Matrix A: System State Transition *)
aMatrixA[1,1] := 0.9945;  aMatrixA[1,2] := 0.0032;  aMatrixA[1,3] := 0.0018;  aMatrixA[1,4] := -0.0008;
aMatrixA[2,1] := 0.0021;  aMatrixA[2,2] := 0.9915;  aMatrixA[2,3] := 0.0045;  aMatrixA[2,4] := 0.0005;
aMatrixA[3,1] := 0.0042;  aMatrixA[3,2] := 0.0058;  aMatrixA[3,3] := 0.9880;  aMatrixA[3,4] := -0.0012;
aMatrixA[4,1] := 0.0015;  aMatrixA[4,2] := -0.0022; aMatrixA[4,3] := -0.0009; aMatrixA[4,4] := 0.9820;

(* Matrix B: Control Input Coupling *)
aMatrixB[1,1] := 0.0145;  aMatrixB[1,2] := -0.0012;
aMatrixB[2,1] := -0.0185; aMatrixB[2,2] := 0.0008;
aMatrixB[3,1] := -0.0092; aMatrixB[3,2] := -0.0025;
aMatrixB[4,1] := -0.0320; aMatrixB[4,2] := -0.0450;

(* Matrix C: Measurement Output Observation Matrix *)
aMatrixC[1,1] := 1.0; aMatrixC[1,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[1,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[2,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,2] := 1.0; aMatrixC[2,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[2,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[3,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[3,3] := 1.0; aMatrixC[3,4] := 0.0;
aMatrixC[4,1] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,2] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,3] := 0.0; aMatrixC[4,4] := 1.0;

(* Observer Gain Matrix L (Kalman/Luenberger pole placement) *)
aObserverGainL[1,1] := 0.185; aObserverGainL[1,2] := 0.012; aObserverGainL[1,3] := 0.005; aObserverGainL[1,4] := 0.001;
aObserverGainL[2,1] := 0.010; aObserverGainL[2,2] := 0.192; aObserverGainL[2,3] := 0.008; aObserverGainL[2,4] := 0.002;
aObserverGainL[3,1] := 0.006; aObserverGainL[3,2] := 0.011; aObserverGainL[3,3] := 0.178; aObserverGainL[3,4] := 0.003;
aObserverGainL[4,1] := 0.002; aObserverGainL[4,2] := 0.004; aObserverGainL[4,3] := 0.005; aObserverGainL[4,4] := 0.210;

(* 7.2 Assemble Process Measurements into Vector y *)
aOutputMeasurement_y[1] := rIHX_LBE_OutletTemp_DegC;
aOutputMeasurement_y[2] := rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC;
aOutputMeasurement_y[3] := (rIHX_LBE_OutletTemp_DegC + rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC) * 0.5;
aOutputMeasurement_y[4] := rFilt_StratDeltaT_DegC;

(* 7.3 Observer State Correction Step: e = y - C*x_hat *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aObserverResidual_e[iRow] := aOutputMeasurement_y[iRow] - aStateEstimate_x[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* State Update: x_hat[k+1] = A*x_hat[k] + B*u[k] + L*e[k] *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow] + (aMatrixA[iRow, iCol] * aStateEstimate_x[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow] + (aMatrixB[iRow, 1] * aControlInput_u[1]) + (aMatrixB[iRow, 2] * aControlInput_u[2]);
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        aStatePredicted_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow] + (aObserverGainL[iRow, iCol] * aObserverResidual_e[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Transfer predicted states to estimate registers *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    aStateEstimate_x[iRow] := aStatePredicted_x[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* 7.4 Model Predictive Control (MPC) Quadratic Cost Optimization *)
(* MPC Cost Formulation: J = sum((x_hat - r)^T * Q * (x_hat - r)) + u^T * R * u + delta_u^T * S * delta_u *)
(* State Reference Trajectories *)
aStateSetpoint_r[1] := 550.0; (* Target Hot Leg Temperature [deg C] *)
aStateSetpoint_r[2] := 380.0; (* Target Cold Leg Temperature [deg C] *)
aStateSetpoint_r[3] := 440.0; (* Target Bayonet Wall Temperature [deg C] *)
aStateSetpoint_r[4] := 0.0;   (* Target Stratification Differential [deg C] *)

(* Weighting Factors *)
aWeightMatrixQ[1] := 1.50;  (* Hot leg error penalty *)
aWeightMatrixQ[2] := 1.80;  (* Cold leg error penalty *)
aWeightMatrixQ[3] := 0.80;  (* Wall thermal gradient penalty *)
aWeightMatrixQ[4] := 4.50;  (* Thermal stratification penalty *)
aWeightMatrixR[1] := 0.08;  (* Pump control effort penalty *)
aWeightMatrixR[2] := 0.05;  (* Vortex mixer effort penalty *)
aWeightMatrixS[1] := 0.25;  (* Pump slew penalty *)
aWeightMatrixS[2] := 0.15;  (* Vortex slew penalty *)

(* Calculate Quadratic Cost and Numerical Gradient *)
rMPC_PredictedCost := 0.0;
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rMPC_PredictedCost := rMPC_PredictedCost + (aWeightMatrixQ[iRow] * (aStateEstimate_x[iRow] - aStateSetpoint_r[iRow]) * (aStateEstimate_x[iRow] - aStateSetpoint_r[iRow]));
END_FOR;
rMPC_PredictedCost := rMPC_PredictedCost + (aWeightMatrixR[1] * aControlInput_u[1] * aControlInput_u[1]) +
                                          (aWeightMatrixR[2] * aControlInput_u[2] * aControlInput_u[2]);

(* Analytical Gradient Approximations for Feedback Slew *)
rGradientPump := (2.0 * aWeightMatrixQ[4] * (aStateEstimate_x[4] - aStateSetpoint_r[4]) * aMatrixB[4,1]) +
                 (2.0 * aWeightMatrixR[1] * aControlInput_u[1]) +
                 (2.0 * aWeightMatrixS[1] * (aControlInput_u[1] - aControlInputPrev_u[1]));

rGradientVortex := (2.0 * aWeightMatrixQ[4] * (aStateEstimate_x[4] - aStateSetpoint_r[4]) * aMatrixB[4,2]) +
                   (2.0 * aWeightMatrixR[2] * aControlInput_u[2]) +
                   (2.0 * aWeightMatrixS[2] * (aControlInput_u[2] - aControlInputPrev_u[2]));

(* Projected Gradient Descent Step with Adaptive Learning Rate (gamma = 0.045) *)
rOptimalPumpIncrement := -0.045 * rGradientPump;
rOptimalVortexIncrement := -0.045 * rGradientVortex;

(* Save previous control inputs for slew penalty *)
aControlInputPrev_u[1] := aControlInput_u[1];
aControlInputPrev_u[2] := aControlInput_u[2];

(* =====================================================================================================================
 * SECTION 8.0: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) PLANT LIFECYCLE CONTROLLER
 * =====================================================================================================================
 * Orchestrates secondary LBE loop operational modes from pre-heating and melting through full thermal power
 * synchronization, cavitation derating, SGTR freeze isolation, and decay heat safe scram containment.
 * ===================================================================================================================== *)

CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: COLD STANDBY, TRACE HEATING & COVER GAS PURGE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := FALSE;
        rCurrentPumpCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rBTSG_FeedwaterTrimDemand_pct := 0.0;

        IF bMasterEnable AND bSafetyInterlockRelease AND NOT bEmergencyTripManual THEN

        IF (rVoted_IHX_InletTemp_DegC > 205.0) AND bFreezePlugIsOpenLiquid THEN

        rCurrentPumpCommand_pct := 20.0 + (rTargetThermalPowerDemand_MWth / 750.0) * 75.0;

        rCurrentPumpCommand_pct := rCurrentPumpCommand_pct + rOptimalPumpIncrement;

        IF bStratificationAlert THEN

        bSystemReady := TRUE;

        IF bStratificationAlert THEN

        IF (rCavitationIndex_Sigma > 1.95) AND (rNetCavitationAcoustic_dB < 12.0) THEN

        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;

        rCurrentPumpCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rBTSG_FeedwaterTrimDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 100.0;

        tFreezePlugQuenchTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8S);
        IF tFreezePlugQuenchTimer.Q THEN

                dwDiagnosticsWord := dwDiagnosticsWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* SGTR Isolation Successfully Hermetic *)

        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;

        rCurrentPumpCommand_pct := 12.0;
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 8.0;
        rBTSG_FeedwaterTrimDemand_pct := 4.0;

        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 0.0;

            iState := 0; (* Cold park *)
        END_IF;

            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;

        rCurrentPumpCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rCurrentVortexCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rBTSG_FeedwaterTrimDemand_pct := 0.0;

        rFreezePlug_HeatingPowerDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rFreezePlug_CryoCoolingDemand_pct := 80.0;

        (* Unlatch evaluation *)
        IF bResetFaultLatches AND NOT bReactorScramActive AND NOT bEmergencyTripManual THEN
            bSystemTripped := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Return to cold standby *)
        END_IF;
